exposure: Maternal suspected bacterial infection requiring antibiotics during labor
outcome: Invasive Haemophilus influenzae disease (NTHi, serotype f, serotype b)
cohort: The study included all laboratory-confirmed cases of invasive H. influenzae disease in live-born infants aged <=31 days in England and Wales from 2009-2013.
finding: Early-onset neonatal NTHi disease is strongly associated with premature birth and causes significant morbidity and mortality, with incidence increasing exponentially with prematurity.
followup_time: Acute outcomes were observed within 31 days of birth; long-term complications were reported for survivors but the duration of follow-up is not specified.
gest_age: From <28 weeks' gestation to term neonates.
